Installing, assembling and commissioning new machines at customer locations. Diagnosing and resolving mechanical, electrical and automation-related malfunctions. Carrying out machine modifications, upgrades and conversions. Providing both on-site and remote technical support. Advising customers and sharing technical expertise to solve operational problems. Training customer employees in the correct operation and maintenance of the machinery. Preparing accurate service, quality and installation reports. Maintaining clear communication with customers and the Field Service Manager. Depending on customer demand, you may also support customers in other parts of Europe. What can you expect from Xelvin? A gross monthly salary between €4,200 and €5,200, depending on your knowledge and experience. A company car, including private use. Paid overtime and 25 annual leave days. Training and career development opportunities. A complete relocation package when required, including a relocation budget, housing support, assistance with the 30% ruling, and support with arranging your BSN, bank account and health insurance. What do we expect from you? You are a practical and customer-focused engineer who enjoys working independently in an international service environment. You bring: At least five years of relevant experience as a Field Service Engineer, Mechatronics Engineer or Service Technician. Strong mechanical knowledge, as approximately 60% of the position is mechanically focused. Good electrical and automation knowledge, representing approximately 40% of the role. Experience with industrial machinery, production equipment or packaging machines. Experience with troubleshooting, commissioning and preventive maintenance. Knowledge of Siemens S7 and TIA Portal is an advantage. Knowledge of Bosch Rexroth servo systems is an advantage. Good written and spoken English. A valid driving licence. The willingness to travel regularly throughout the Benelux, Scandinavia and other parts of Europe. Availability to travel up to approximately 75% of your working time by car or aeroplane.
